column1: # Tolbi, after Ash Jenna: Isaac asks Mia for the Tideglass Blade.

column3: Mia, Jenna said the light\nmade you both. Is she\nright?{end_wait}
Careful, Isaac. You talk to\nme as if you'd forgotten\nyour place.{end_wait}
That blade isn't yours, is\nit? Give it to me.{end_wait}
Fool. The voice you hate\nwas never mine. It came\nwith the sword.{end_wait}
It speaks when I'm angry or\nafraid, and I can't make it\nstop.{end_wait}

Then choose, Isaac. Take
the blade and leave me
weak, or trust me.{page_break}Will you take the Tideglass
Blade?{end_now}
Then take it. I'll be\nweaker and quieter, and\nmaybe that's a mercy.{end_wait}
You'd rather keep me as I\nam. Pity or wisdom, I won't\nthank you for it.{end_wait}
